name: pack-carton-plain
prompt: A small single-serve rectangular drink carton of the tetra-brik kind standing upright, the carton in teal and white with a simple illustration of ripe mango slices with a green leaf on its side, a bent white paper straw poking out of the top corner, the carton completely blank apart from that illustration, with no brand name, no words and no label, the carton filling about two thirds of the frame height. Soft 3D render in a premium product-illustration style: matte clay-like materials with real surface detail, studio softbox lighting from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion and a soft contact shadow, three-quarter view, centred with generous margin so nothing touches the frame edges, natural colours with fresh green accents, calm and modern like Apple or Monzo marketing art. Transparent background with no floor surface, only the soft contact shadow. No people, no hands. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
postprocess: contact shadow: pale see-through pixels outside the object recoloured to #0b1510 at 62% of their alpha, so the shadow reads as shadow on light and dark grounds (0 px matched: this render's shadow is already dark); then a 768x768 WebP, cwebp -q 85 -alpha_q 100 -resize 768 768; the PNG original stays local in src/
